integrity: The proof reconstructs the source substitution and tracks both possible losses: the normalized Jacobian is strictly below one when the first prefix is slack, and the transformed Gaussian exponent is strictly larger whenever a later prefix is slack. The bundled symbolic checker verifies the algebraic identities but is not used as a substitute for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies equality only for the ordered-square comparison and the resulting local orthoscheme surface-to-sector estimate. It does not establish global uniqueness of the cube in the full polytope surface-area theorem and gives no quantitative stability modulus. The normalized one-dimensional comparison is non-rigid.
title: Rigidity of the ordered-square comparison behind the sharp Vaaler surface bound
